channel.description: Latest articles from Audio Media International Ltd (audiomediainternational.com)

item.title: Audio-Technica ATH-R70xa receives TEC Award Recognition at NAMM 2026
item.description: Audio-Technica’s ATH-R70xa open-back reference headphones have been honoured with a Technical Excellence and Creativity Award in the Headphone and Earpiece Technology category at the 41st Annual TEC Awards, presented during the 2026 NAMM Show in Anaheim, California.

item.title: Tommy Torres highlights the importance of honest monitoring in music production
item.description: Latin Grammy-winning producer and songwriter Tommy Torres has spoken about the importance of accurate monitoring and midrange clarity in his creative workflow, citing KRK studio monitors as a key component of his Miami-based production setup.

item.title: DALI Showcases THX Certified Dominus SUB V-16 F at ISE 2026
item.description: Danish loudspeaker manufacturer DALI is present at Integrated Systems Europe (ISE) 2026 in Barcelona to spotlight its most powerful subwoofer to date, the SUB V-16 F, marking its official show debut as a THX Certified Dominus product. The certification represents the highest performance tier within the THX programme and signals DALI’s first collaboration with the organisation.

item.title: Source-Connect 4 Becomes First metadata-connected Dolby® Atmos remote review & approval tool
item.description: Source Elements have announced that Source-Connect 4 has become the industry's first remote collaboration solution to achieve Dolby Atmos certification with metadata connection to the Dolby Atmos Renderer. With 128 audio streaming channels supporting any combination of beds and objects—plus full metadata integration—the update connects immersive environments like never before. item.title: The Ivors Academy launches formal presence in Ireland: The Edge speaks...
item.description: The Ivors Academy launches formal presence in Ireland with Catherine Martin to lead policy The Ivors Academy has announced the launch of The Ivors Academy in Ireland, marking its first formal presence outside the UK in more than 80 years. The move establishes a dedicated home for songwriters and composers across the entire island of Ireland, with a focus on protection, empowerment and celebration of music writers at every stage of their careers.

item.title: Audiotonix Expands Portfolio with Acquisition of DPA Microphones, Wisycom and Austrian Audio
item.description: Audiotonix has announced a significant expansion of its professional audio portfolio with plans to acquire three respected brands in microphone and wireless audio technology. DPA Microphones, Wisycom and Austrian Audio are set to join the Audiotonix group, subject to regulatory approval, with completion expected in the first half of 2026.

item.title: From the vault: In the studio with Prince: Susan Rogers on recording: "He was not a lordly type. He was a working man. He had a strong work ethic"
item.description: In 1983 a phone call about a job opening in Minneapolis changed Susan Rogers' life forever. Working as Prince’s staff engineer for five years, she’d spend day and night behind the desk and tape machines to ensure that he was able to record his limitless stream of musical ideas…

item.title: Focal Utopia Main 212 Monitors Installed at Studio DMI Las Vegas
item.description: High-end monitoring has taken another step forward at Studio DMI in Las Vegas with the installation of Focal’s flagship Utopia Main 212 monitors, soffit-mounted as part of a major room upgrade designed by Haverstick Designs. The new system places Focal’s most advanced main monitors at the heart of the studio’s flagship stereo mixing space, delivering a powerful new reference environment for Grammy-nominated mix and mastering engineer Luca Pretolesi.

item.title: Yamaha launches 'Creator Pass' platform at SXSW to unify music and podcast tools
item.description: Yamaha has unveiled a new digital platform designed to simplify the creative workflow for musicians, producers and podcasters, bringing together a wide range of software tools and services under a single subscription. Announced by Yamaha’s US-based subsidiary Yamaha Music Innovations, the new Yamaha Creator Pass platform will debut publicly at the South by Southwest (SXSW) event in Austin, Texas, with demonstrations running from 13–15 March.

item.title: Akai Professional launches portable MPC Sample standalone sampler
item.description: Akai Professional has unveiled MPC Sample, a compact standalone sampler designed to bring the company’s iconic MPC workflow to a more accessible and portable format. Inspired by classic systems such as the MPC60, MPC Sample is a battery-powered device that enables producers to sample, chop and build beats without the need for a computer. The launch marks what the company describes as its most accessible standalone sampler to date.
